mechanism_narrative: A sustained downward trend in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, reducing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the federal funds rate above 3.5% triggers a tightening cycle, raising discount rates and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 3.5% in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of FEDFUNDS above 3.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in quarterly demand (GDPC1) and decline in supply (INDPRO) creates an excess demand environment, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 rises while INDPRO falls in the same month
failure_condition: The interaction between GDPC1 and INDPRO does not consistently predict positive returns (e.g., 20-day returns not significantly higher than baseline in 60% of instances).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in unemployment rate below 4.5% signals improving labor market conditions, boosting consumer confidence and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns within the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses below 4.5% in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of UNRATE below 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals monetary accommodation, lowering discount rates and enhancing equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS falls by 1% or more in a month during late-cycle expansion
failure_condition: The mechanism fails if the late-cycle expansion ends or FEDFUNDS decline does not correlate with positive returns (e.g., IC < 0.03 over 2 years).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in monthly employment (PAYEMS) reflects strong labor market growth, increasing consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS trend does not predict positive returns (e.g., 20-day returns not significantly higher than baseline in 60% of instances).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and a decline in unemployment rate (improving labor market) creates conflicting signals, tightening monetary policy while labor market strengthens, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises while UNRATE falls in the same month
failure_condition: The interaction between FEDFUNDS and UNRATE does not consistently predict negative returns (e.g., 20-day returns not significantly lower than baseline in 60% of instances).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden surge in supply growth (INDPRO exceeding 105) indicates robust production capacity, reducing inflationary pressures and supporting equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns within the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO crosses above 105 in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of INDPRO above 105 (t-test p > 0.05).
